mike chen: Quick Q — our 1pm panel for candidate C-224 on Thu conflicts with Elena's timezone (she's IST). Can we shift to 1:30 or 2pm UTC? Need to confirm with candidate and panellists. cc @people-ops-bot for calendar update.
sophia rao: I can do 2pm UTC. Elena?
elena: 2pm UTC works, it's 5:30pm IST for me — fine.
jordan lee: I have a calendar conflict 2-3 UTC. 1:30 UTC would work better on my end.
mike chen: 1:30 would be 5pm IST — that would work for Elena? If yes I'll update; otherwise we need a swap.
elena: 5pm IST is okay for me.
sophia rao: 1:30 works for me too.
people-ops-bot: :spiral_calendar: Event updated: Interview — C-224 — Panel (mike chen, sophia rao, elena, jordan lee) set to Thu 1:30 UTC. Zoom link + materials attached.
jordan lee: Thanks — quick asks: 1) Debrief timing? 5 or 10 min after? 2) Rubric Q3 weight — is it still 20% or bumped to 25% for this role?
mike chen: Debrief 10m after. Rubric Q3 stays 20% for IC3, unless you flag it during debrief. Also candidate asked about recording — do we want to record? Need explicit consent.
people-ops-bot: :warning: Candidate recording consent: not yet captured. Reply here to confirm and bot will send opt-in email to candidate.
elena: I prefer opt-in. Ask candidate to opt-in; if they do, store recording in GDrive with restricted access.
sophia rao: +1 opt-in. Include retention note (30 days) and list who can access (interviewers + people-ops).
mike chen: Agreed. @people-ops-bot please send consent email template and set retention to 30d if they opt in.
people-ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Sent consent email template to candidate. Retention set to 30d on opt-in. Also attached debrief form: https://redwoodops.co/debrief/C-224
jordan lee: One last rubric tweak — for Q2 (system design) please emphasize latency vs cost tradeoffs rather than scaling patterns. I'll add a note in the form.
mike chen: Perfect. If anyone needs to swap cover, ping here ASAP. Otherwise final reminder 24h before. :bell:
